liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews, 1 other source): The performance includes early riffs for the eventual Fire on the Mountain instrumental; This is one of the most epic post-1974 performances of the song [1][6][13]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): The pairing with Comes A Time creates a powerful opening sequence [6]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-06-22.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112218.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 187 min; rated 4.86/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: The uploader cleaned a lot of static from the recording as best as possible [1]
- **gd1976-06-22.akg.moore.berger-minches.99093.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 170 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: This audience recording has less distracting crowd noise than other available versions; Moore's recording is praised for its sound quality despite some lackluster moments [5][15]
- **gd1976-06-22.mtx.seamons.112900.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 188 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1976-06-22.aud.digitalrbb.miller.112789.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 185 min [3]

## Around the show

- Donna and Bobby harmonize effectively, redeeming her vocal performance in this song [10]
- A US flag with a fan flew on Keith's piano during the opening [11]
- The band ended the Tuesday show with this song, a unique occurrence [11]
- The reviewer considers this one of their all-time favorite shows [9]
- The reviewer considers 1976 the most underrated year in the band's history [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-06-22.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112218.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Apogee Ensemble -> Peak -> AIFF [1]. Also: This is the first soundboard recording of the show available on the archive; The patch source was recorded with microphones placed at the soundboard by crew [1][6]
- **gd1976-06-22.akg.moore.berger-minches.99093.flac16**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger and David Minches; source: AKG D1000es>sony tc-152sd cassette [4]
- **gd1976-06-22.mtx.seamons.112900.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Soundtrack > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT) [2]
- **gd1976-06-22.aud.digitalrbb.miller.112789.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller;digitalrbb; source: Unknown Mics -> Master Cassette (Nakamichi 350) [3]
